correctness.rationale: The fixed-good-edge count 2^{r(S)}(n-|S|)! follows by monotone consecutive-integer blocks, including exact orientation and interval-allocation multiplicities. Boolean-lattice Möbius inversion enforces precisely no adjacent missing good edges. The three-state transfer yields the stated rational polynomial generating function and exact all-length coefficient formula, checked symbolically. Direct exhaustive permutation counts through n=10, a separate mask DP through n=14, literal Möbius enumeration through m=9, and transfer state computations through m=59 all reproduce it; no finite test substitutes for the general proof.

value.rationale: The parameter k=1 is the smallest natural tolerance in a flash-memory rank-modulation constraint, not a chosen artificial subcase. Exact finite-length alphabet sizes quantify the space available for finite-block encoding whereas the known asymptotic capacity C(1)=1/2 does not. The transfer-state proof and O(n^2) integer-arithmetic recurrence determine a natural infinite family of exact cardinalities and permit reusable parameter-free computation beyond brute factorial enumeration; no external performance claim is needed.
